text:
Possibly, in part, but this is not yet confirmed.

Hansen/UMD mapped about 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025 on this 345.6 ha property (about 3.9%). The overlap with forest is strong: JRC's 2020 map shows forest on 98% of the affected area, and MGAP's 2021 map classes about 13.1 ha of it as native forest (0.4 ha outside mapped forest, no planted forest).

Limits:
- 2025 is the last year of the series, so there is no later year to show the loss persisted. The assessment is still pending corroboration.
- Hansen loss means any stand replacement, so it does not prove deforestation or a land-use change.
- The evidence doesn't show the cause (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), whether it was authorized, or who was responsible.

Treat it as a probable native-forest loss candidate of about 13 ha, and check again once 2026 data are available.
